training_track: custom-data adaptation; separate from native Phase1 results
selection: Seeded SHA256 ordering of original image IDs within official partitions; no selection on model performance
split_policy: Only official training images enter train. Development and heldout selections come from disjoint official validation images. Kodak24 remains independent evaluation-only.
deduplication: Exact file and decoded-RGB hashes globally; inspect near-duplicate groups and source overlap before launch. All crops follow parent split.
sampling: Each complete epoch visits3800selectedtrainingimages once without source oversampling. Target150epochs with7200second training cap; actual complete/partial epochs and image exposure recorded. Budget stop is not convergence.
preprocessing: ADJSCC initial adaptation: RGB0to1, random256trainingcrop; deterministic256developmentcrop; no horizontal flips because scene text is included. Native-resolution final evaluation separate.
first_model: ADJSCC DiffCom PyTorch C2 checkpoint; pretrained finetuning, not original-paper training reproduction
training_gate: Actual image IDs, file hashes, dimensions, licensing provenance and split manifest must freeze before two-step GPU pilot, then bounded fine-tuning.
native_contract_exclusions: JCM classification labels and SQ-GAN20class paired segmentation are not supplied by this RGB mixture; no dummy labels or masks. No generic replacement algorithms.
test_policy: Only officialtrainingimages optimize weights. Reserve COCO200+TextOCR100 as new customtest; Kodak24 is development-exposed externalbenchmark, never train. Keep actualfrozenmemberships.
notes: This protocol records verified membership but is not itself the full image manifest. Existing native benchmark exposure and pseudo-label limitations remain explicit.
training_hardware: Custom ADJSCC: DataParallel bothT4s, totalbatch8FP32, perimageAWGNnormalization, encoderdevicehooksverifyboth; development evaluationCUDA0
native_input_policy: Use each authors native shape/range/paired-input contract. First ADJSCC experiment remains a recorded adaptation, not universal preprocessing.

custom_label_adaptations.sqgan: Approved frozen Cityscapes19class segmenter maps, preserving native20channel semantic input; include segmentation cost.
custom_label_adaptations.shared_semantic_codebook: Approved frozen native10class classifier pseudo-labels with confidence/domaincoverage; native STL10true-label track separate.
custom_label_adaptations.jcm: Approved separate larger-image reconstruction-only variant; nativeCIFAR10jointtask model preserved.
